baseline.qualification: Some assertions establish new evidence fields; not all failures are distinct invalid prior scientific outcomes.

intermediate_failures.cause: Existing checkpoint-admission test expected no output directory; new evidence contract intentionally retains a rejected attempt. Extended the existing assertion without weakening model-state or evaluation admission.
The extended test lacked its json import; added that test-only import. Production source unchanged.

verification.command: PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 PYTHONPATH=. OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 python -m pytest -q -W error tests

independent_review.findings: Exact prediction shape prevents cross-sample broadcast; finite target/prediction/uncertainty admitted before metrics; fsynced per-batch started/completed journal retains prior batch; exclusive attempt and hard-link final publication preserve existing evidence.

limitations: Durability covers catchable failures and interruptions with a writable filesystem; arbitrary process death or disk failure can prevent final evidence.
Per-batch input fingerprints and scalar diagnostics are retained; full per-example raw predictions and independent-unit statistical analysis are not added.
Atomic final publication requires filesystem hard-link support; failure is explicit and does not replace existing output.
Existing metric equations are retained; finite representability is checked, not a universal precision guarantee.
Model architecture, training losses, tasks, synthetic streams, checkpoints and all historical research results are unchanged.
UNVALIDATED_INFRASTRUCTURE and prospective scientific gates remain unchanged.
